prompt: How old would James Logan have been when the estate of his descendent donated Neshaminy State Park land to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania?
answer: James Logan was born on October 20, 1674. In 1956, when Robert R. Logan’s estate donated the land, James Logan would have been **282 years old** (hypothetically).
